forbidden_changes: denominator, support threshold, support definitions, F1-range rule, estimator, or Wilson reporting
scorer, evaluator, reference bytes, prompt/corpus order, program, model/checkpoint, tokenizer, or renderer
sampling, termination, timeouts, K=4 topology, no-resampling rule, failure reward, or target timing/selection
serial execution, retry-zero semantics, evidence rules, or scientific master/group namespace

branch_protocol.candidate_seed_derivation: HMAC-SHA256(master_seed, canonical JSON of domain, rollout_id, target_id, purpose=candidate_action, action_slot), first 8 bytes big-endian masked to 63 bits.
branch_protocol.composition: One exactly recorded action plus three direct single-sample candidates.
branch_protocol.deterministic_scorer: Verbatim span precision/recall/F1 bytes bound by the frozen evaluator program and source references.
branch_protocol.topology_divergence: Recorded as an ordinary deterministic branch outcome under the frozen event-replay finalizer; never repaired or resampled.

reporting: fixed 95% Wilson intervals with exact denominators

source_measurement_semantics: max-token actions are canonical after exact termination proof even if truncated typed content does not round-trip
strict restart reload preserves those completed max-token actions

scorer_evaluator_and_references.deterministic_scorer: Verbatim span precision/recall/F1 bytes bound by the frozen evaluator program and source references.

support_definitions.N_eligible: N_scaffold and both frozen targets were pre-action committed with exact source topology, restorability, replayability, and total outer weight one.
support_definitions.N_joint: N_eligible and at least one of the two K=4 target groups has reward-F1 range at least 0.05.
support_definitions.N_scaffold: Both predeclared first-turn children were produced.

target_timing_and_selection.commitment_timing: Each target is committed before its source action is reserved and before any reward, reference answer, or realized model output is inspected.
target_timing_and_selection.natural_extra_topology: Well-formed additional topology is handled only by the frozen finalizer and may make the source denominator-negative.
target_timing_and_selection.replacement_forbidden: Extra children, later turns, reward-bearing calls, and apparently promising calls never replace either frozen target.
